rationale: int bit_length<=256 and finite float are number-admission invariants of the sandbox executor; not a policy dial
10000-key dict ceiling is an engine DoS guard inside the admission evaluator; exact-str keys is an invariant; no policy owner or consumer value
10000-item ceiling is an engine DoS guard; exact-type plain-builtin check is a sandbox invariant (type(item) exact)
required-string operation fields (empty/non-str refuse) is a binding-completeness floor in snapshot validation
unknown/lost-ack to TimeoutError and closed definitive-rejection code set: protocol semantics; widening would permit unsafe retry
grant validity-interval check against authoritative state at claim time is an authority-enforcement evaluator
synthetic=True opt-in and required-table prerequisites are guards that keep a synthetic ledger out of production admission
default escalate-when-unmatched is the fail-closed terminal rule of the gate; frame tool lists are caller data
rule order and first-match return are the evaluation algorithm; reordering could weaken block-before-allow precedence
literal report keys and 'unknown' version bucket are report schema/closed vocabulary, not policy
taint reason strings and kind=='split' rule are closed vocabulary and evidence-interpretation logic (comparison caveat)
exact-identifier predicate is an identity-canonicality invariant (E024)
catch-all to E999 is the fail-closed wrapper of the validator
required manifest fields and supported-version set are schema/validator invariants
unique, present, exact action_id are identity invariants of v1.1 manifests
effectful action must carry closed targets, authority_context, effect_limits: constitutional floor. Limit values are manifest/issuer data
external_send/privileged/high-risk allow need authority and review: mandatory authority floor; _PRIVILEGED set is a closed taxonomy
payload-policy set-consistency and reviewer_role rules are structural validity checks, no variation
profile version, canonicalization id and SHA-256 are evidence-integrity protocol constants
canonical JSON form and sha256: commitment are evidence-integrity mechanism; changing breaks verification
type/range checks on obligation fields; max_age_seconds VALUE is issuer requirement data, this is only its validator
MAX_TEXT=200 is a cosmetic log-truncation cap beside log-injection escaping; no authority, owner or governance consumer. Reclassified from candidate
binding generation literal and tenant_id 1..128 are record schema/protocol constants
input_type and age_basis literals are closed vocabularies of the evidence schema
result and time_source literals are closed decision-custody vocabulary
append-only merge/escalation persistence in one transaction; irreversible-effect custody mechanism (limits live in profiles)
age-extension recording delegates to extension_defects (signer-set + cap checks); authority-widening path stays in code, caps in profile

ObservationPolicy max_age_seconds/clock_tolerance_seconds: real freshness threshold; None already holds (observation_policy_missing); registry can only min() caller value, like F4 siblings. Not covered
blocking_decision: Which code-owned ceiling/baseline do registry values narrow, and is tolerance narrow-only (min) alongside max_age?

rationale: workflow age-extension: requires freshness profile, known class, signer in configured set; authority-widening mechanism
pre-dispatch expiry re-check with monotonic and clock-step guards is an enforcement algorithm; tolerance is a ctor param elsewhere
observation structural/binding checks are an evaluator; its age thresholds come from ObservationPolicy (see W6-042)
scalar allowlist is a data-minimisation rule for retained evidence; weakening leaks payload or identity
issued-grant and acting-identity binding is authority verification
grant status/revision/tenant/freshness checks are authority enforcement; age bounds are separately governed (F4/F5)
conflict clear-state and binding check is an authority-conflict evaluator
evidence-obligation evaluator (required authorization must be current/fresh). Per-obligation max_age is issuer/requirement data, not registry
effective_age_bound is the evaluator that can RAISE an age bound under signed extensions; widening algorithm must stay in code
Reaper fail-closed liveness and thread loop; interval already a FreshnessProfile field, 1.0s poll/5s join are mechanism
reversibility member-consistency and derived irreversible flag: closed validation, strict default for protected reads
operation-id regex (128 chars) is an identifier-syntax protocol constant used by dedupe/merge/identity
issuance snapshot tenant/institution/grant/requirement/commitment binding checks are authority verification
every approval ref must be active and binding-consistent: authority verification
classify time semantics (inclusive deadline) is a pure evaluator; the horizon/deadline/ttl numbers are DedupeProfile fields
replay bundle serialization/deserialization is evidence format; indent default cosmetic
